semiconductor_relevance: High — Cimetrix provides critical software solutions for equipment connectivity and control in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Cimetrix, part of PDF Solutions, specializes in equipment connectivity products that enhance smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 initiatives. Their software enables seamless communication between manufacturing equipment and factory software systems, improving productivity and reducing costs.
capabilities: Equipment connectivity solutions for smart manufacturing
Implementation of SEMI connectivity standards (SECS/GEM, GEM300, EDA/Interface A, PV2)
